review.decision: Approved the frozen 382-file platform-identity closure after reading independent runtime and qualification reviews. Full descriptor metadata is retained consistently during read, pathname rebinding and immutable lifetime checks; eager native registration and loaded-file checks remain mandatory. The WP8/WP7 test split preserves every original certificate assertion under its owning component, and the portable Win32 test fixture now supplies drive-qualified image paths without changing production validation. Actual Windows diagnostics and the affected regression runs substantiate the fixes. The final focused run passed 336 tests with six platform-dependent skips; overlapping runtime and predicate-replay results are separately scoped. Numerical C++ sources, vendor bytes, schemas, policy and adapter authority are unchanged. The Python consumer identity changes and is explicitly reviewed. Source approval is separate from artifact qualification: fresh exact-head complete CI and final-byte acceptance remain mandatory.
